screen.$description: Main app background — lowest layer, always behind everything. Changing this shifts the overall mood of the product. | ai-group:expressiveness | ai-impact:high

elevated.$description: Elevated surface above screen — page content areas, sidebar backgrounds. Must always appear lighter than background/screen to communicate depth. | ai-group:expressiveness | ai-impact:high | ai-constraint:must be lighter than background/screen

scrim.$description: Semi-transparent scrim behind modals, drawers, bottom sheets. Alpha 0.25–0.6: too low loses focus, too high feels oppressive. | ai-group:depth | ai-impact:medium | ai-behavior:appears-with-modal

primary.$description: Default surface for cards, panels, modal bodies, list containers. Most common surface in the system. | ai-group:expressiveness | ai-impact:high | ai-behavior:use-on-background-screen

secondary.$description: Slightly off-white surface for nested containers, table rows, secondary panels. Creates subtle depth within a primary surface. | ai-group:expressiveness | ai-impact:medium | ai-constraint:must be visually distinct from surface/primary | ai-behavior: use-on-surface-primary

tertiary.$description: Deeply nested surfaces — third-level containers, inline code blocks. | ai-group:expressiveness | ai-impact:low

accent.$description: Brand-tinted surface for selected states, highlighted rows, active nav backgrounds. Always a very light tint of the accent color — never saturated. | ai-group:expressiveness | ai-impact:medium

disabled.$description: Background of disabled interactive surfaces. Communicates non-interactivity. Do not change. | ai-group:locked | ai-locked:true

floating.$description: Surface color of modals, bottom sheets, popovers — the element appearing above the background/overlay scrim. | ai-group:expressiveness | ai-impact:medium | ai-behavior: use-above-background-scrim

primary.$description: Fill color for primary buttons and secondary outline stroke. In light mode near-black, in dark mode near-white — always the opposite of the button foreground. | ai-group:expressiveness | ai-impact:high

primary-inverse.$description: Fill for primary buttons inverse. In light mode near-white, in dark mode near-black — always the opposite of the button foreground. | ai-group:expressiveness | ai-impact:high

secondary.$description: Fill color for secondary, ghost, and outline buttons. Muted gray — communicates lower visual priority than action/primary. Also used for tertiary icon button fills. | ai-group:expressiveness | ai-impact:medium

disabled.$description: Fill color of disabled buttons and controls. Flat muted gray that signals non-interactivity. | ai-group:locked | ai-impact:low | ai-locked:true

distructive.$description: Fill color of destructive button surfaces (delete, remove, danger CTAs). Signals irreversibility and risk. Always red-family hue — never change the hue, only lightness allowed. Text on this background must use action/destructive-content. | ai-group:locked | ai-locked:true | ai-constraint:always red-family hue, action/destructive-content must maintain 4.5:1 on this background

accent.$description:
Fill for accent-colored interactive elements — links, active tabs, 
selected chips. Draws attention without the weight of action/primary.
| ai-group:expressiveness | ai-impact:medium

primary.$description: Main body text, headings, primary labels. Highest-contrast text color in the system. | ai-group:expressiveness | ai-impact:high | ai-constraint:7:1 contrast vs background/elevated for AAA compliance

secondary.$description: Supporting text — captions, metadata, helper text, timestamps. Clearly subordinate to content/primary. | ai-group:expressiveness | ai-impact:medium | ai-constraint:4.5:1 contrast vs surface/primary

disabled.$description: Placeholder text, ghost labels, very subtle hints. Lowest legibility tier — never use for critical information. | ai-group:expressiveness | ai-impact:low | ai-constraint:minimum 3:1 contrast

primary-inverse.$description: Primary text on dark surfaces — tooltips, dark cards, filled dark headers, primary buttons Inverse of content/primary. | ai-group:expressiveness | ai-impact:medium

accent.$description: Accent-colored text — inline links, active labels, highlighted values. Always the brand color applied to text. | ai-group:expressiveness | ai-impact:medium | ai-constraint:4.5:1 contrast vs surface/primary

divider.$description: Passive structural dividers — between list rows, table cells, section separators. Should be barely perceptible. If clearly visible at arm's length it is too strong. | ai-group:weight | ai-impact:medium

outline.$description: Border of interactive form elements at rest — inputs, selects, textareas. Must clearly define the clickable area. Always stronger than border/divider. | ai-group:weight | ai-impact:medium | ai-constraint:must be stronger than border/divider

action.$description: Border of outline-variant interactive elements — outline buttons, active input borders. Matches content/accent for consistency. | ai-group:expressiveness | ai-impact:medium

overlay.$description: Universal hover overlay — semi-transparent layer on top of any interactive surface on mouse enter. Apply to buttons, list items, nav items. Flips to white-opacity in dark mode. | ai-group:locked | ai-impact:medium | ai-behavior: on-filled-elements-only

fill.$description: Solid hover state for list rows and table rows where an overlay layer is not possible. Changes the background directly. | ai-group:locked | ai-impact:medium

selected.$description:
Solid background for selected rows, active nav items, chosen list options. 
Indicates persistent selection rather than transient hover.
| ai-group:interactivity | ai-impact:medium

overlay.$description: Universal pressed/active overlay — stronger than state/hover. Applied on mouse down for tactile feedback. Alpha always greater than state/hover. | ai-group:locked | ai-constraint:alpha must be > state/hover alpha

fill.$description: Solid pressed state for list rows where overlay is not possible. | ai-group:locked | ai-impact:low

focus-ring.$description:
Color of the keyboard focus indicator ring drawn around interactive elements. 
Must remain high-contrast and always visible — never suppress or hide.
| ai-group:accessibility | ai-impact:high | ai-locked:true

background-strong.$description:
Saturated green surface — badge fill, status pill, prominent success indicator. 
Use when success needs high visibility against surrounding content.
| ai-group:feedback | ai-impact:medium

background-light.$description:
Tinted green surface — success alert background, inline success message container. 
Softer than background-strong, used for larger areas of positive feedback.
| ai-group:feedback | ai-impact:medium

foreground.$description:
Text and icon color for positive/success content. 
| ai-group:feedback | ai-impact:medium | ai-behavior:use-above-background-scrim

border.$description:
Border of success-state containers, inputs, and alert boxes. 
Pairs with background-light to frame positive feedback areas.
| ai-group:feedback | ai-impact:low

background-strong.$description:
Saturated amber surface — warning badge, caution pill. 
Use sparingly — warns without blocking user action.
| ai-group:feedback | ai-impact:medium

background-light.$description:
Tinted amber surface — warning alert background, caution message container.
| ai-group:feedback | ai-impact:medium

foreground.$description:
Text and icon color for warning content.
Use on background-light or white — never on background-strong.
| ai-group:feedback | ai-impact:medium

border.$description:
Border of warning-state containers and alert boxes.
| ai-group:feedback | ai-impact:low

background-strong.$description:
Saturated red surface — error badge, destructive status pill.
Use for explicit errors that require immediate attention.
| ai-group:feedback | ai-impact:high

background-light.$description:
Tinted red surface — error alert background, inline error message container.
| ai-group:feedback | ai-impact:high

foreground.$description:
Text and icon color for error and destructive content.
Use on background-light or white — never on background-strong.
| ai-group:feedback | ai-impact:high

border.$description:
Border of error-state inputs, containers, and alert boxes.
Signals invalid input or system failure — pairs with background-light.
| ai-group:feedback | ai-impact:high

background-strong.$description:
Neutral gray surface — default badge, unclassified status pill.
Use when status has no positive or negative connotation.
| ai-group:feedback | ai-impact:low

background-light.$description:
Tinted neutral surface — informational alert background, generic tag container.
| ai-group:feedback | ai-impact:low

foreground.$description:
Text and icon color for neutral informational content.
| ai-group:feedback | ai-impact:low

border.$description:
Border of neutral-state containers and informational alert boxes.
| ai-group:feedback | ai-impact:low

soft.$description:
Shadow color for lowest-elevation surfaces — subtle cards, resting panels.
Scales automatically between light and dark mode.
| ai-group:depth | ai-impact:low

medium.$description:
Shadow color for mid-elevation surfaces — dropdowns, popovers, floating menus.
| ai-group:depth | ai-impact:medium

strong.$description:
Shadow color for highest-elevation surfaces — modals, dialogs, command palettes.
| ai-group:depth | ai-impact:high

background-strong.$description:
Saturated blue surface — categorical label, tag, or data point requiring blue identity.
Use for data-driven color coding only, not for UI feedback meaning.
| ai-group:expression | ai-impact:low

background-light.$description:
Tinted blue surface — larger categorical area, selected filter chip with blue identity.
| ai-group:expression | ai-impact:low

foreground.$description: Text and icon color for blue categorical content. Use on neutral surfaces (surface/primary, surface/secondary) for colored labels, tags, and status text. When used on expression surfaces, always match the same color family.

Primary brand accent. Not for general UI chrome — use action/primary for buttons.
